summary: Pre-market, the discount rate is still the constraint and the tape is still the support. The composite added 0.84 to 44.05 with the regime unchanged at goldilocks and confidence at 0.9083, but the composition is narrow: macro at 68.79 remains the heaviest block, and the newest rate observation puts the 10Y at 5.01, the 2Y at 4.76 and the 10Y real rate at 2.68 — the 10Y and the real rate both at the 100.0th percentile — against credit (HY OAS 2.68, IG OAS 0.77) and volatility (VIX 14.81) that price no stress at all. The last completed US session was a broad AI-complex advance: semiconductors 4.9281, quantum computing 4.7678, AI infrastructure 4.6307 and semis 4.1082 led, AMD 9.9496 was the single-name standout, and only memory -0.2933 and consumer electronics -0.0889 closed lower, leaving the panel 20 of 22 positive rather than unanimous. Overnight flow is mostly the energy premium being unwound — Saudi Arabia is restarting the East-West pipeline and Yanbu loadings while Iran signals conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz — which matters here because a lower crude price is the one channel that can ease the real-rate constraint without a policy move. Asia supplied the genuinely new input: the tracked A-share panel closed 6 of 11 higher, led by 688008.sh 5.5831 and 002156.sz 3.8248, with 300475.sz -1.0917 the worst, and 688525.sh -0.1655 announced a third-phase wafer-level advanced packaging project after the bell.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Macro remains the binding block at 68.79: the 10Y real rate of 2.68 and the 10Y yield of 5.01 are both at the 100.0th percentile, so the constraint sits at the top of its observed range, not inside it.
The front end led the repricing on the newest observation: the 2Y moved 4.67 to 4.76 while the 10Y moved 4.94 to 5.01, flattening the 10Y/2Y curve to 0.25.

Cross-asset confirmation is still the largest single contribution at 7.50 and still sits at 0.375: dollar_strength, real_rate_pressure and small_cap_underperformance are all triggered, with the dollar index at 119.5133.
The liquidity cushion is close to exhausted: reverse repo at 0.582 sits in the 4.34th percentile with a risk score of 91.33, against reserves of 3013794.0.
Credit prices no risk at all: HY OAS 2.68 and IG OAS 0.77 sit in the 8.41st and 13.39th percentiles, so the macro block and the credit market are describing different regimes.

supporting_signals.claim: The risk-on tape was broad: 20 of 22 sectors and themes advanced, led by semiconductors 4.9281, quantum computing 4.7678 and AI infrastructure 4.6307.
The move was led by AI hardware single names rather than broad beta: AMD 9.9496, TSLA 3.028, MU 2.7722, NVDA 2.299 and AVGO 1.4122 all closed higher.
The A-share gainers were concentrated in the same hardware complex: 688008.sh 5.5831 and 002156.sz 3.8248 led, with 603986.sh 2.6525 and 688825.sh 1.7229 also higher.
Volatility is anchored: VIX 14.81 sits in the 20.56th percentile and realised vol is 10.6356, holding the volatility dimension at 16.82.
New highs expanded to 0.0452 against new lows of 0.0387, with 0.6 of the universe above its 200-day average.
The liquidity backdrop is still expanding: the Fed balance sheet at 6746548.0 and reserves at 3013794.0, with SOFR at 3.85.

contradicting_signals.claim: 2 of the 22 sectors closed lower — memory -0.2933 and consumer electronics -0.0889 — so the AI advance was not unanimous and the leadership narrowed at the margin.
The leaders are still far from repaired on a relative basis: semis relative -18.5165 and small cap relative -8.1362.
Overnight press framed Treasuries as easing while the fact layer shows the 10Y at 5.01 against 4.94 previously — the two are describing different sessions, and the settled reading is the higher one.
Asia did not confirm the US hardware bid: the tracked A-share panel closed 6 of 11 higher while the memory and module names led the decline, with 300475.sz -1.0917 and 001309.sz -0.8265.
Confidence is high at 0.9083 but consistency is the weak factor at 0.6813, meaning the inputs corroborate each other less than they corroborate the model.

what_changed_today: The composite added 0.84 to 44.05, its first gain after the pullback, with trend_1w at -1.18 and trend_1m at -0.65.
The rate block rolled to a new observation and moved up across the curve: 10Y from 4.94 to 5.01, 2Y from 4.67 to 4.76, the real rate from 2.61 to 2.68, and the 10Y/2Y curve from 0.27 to 0.25.
AMD 9.9496 led the tracked US panel, ahead of TSLA 3.028, MU 2.7722, NVDA 2.299 and AVGO 1.4122.
Of the 22 sectors, 20 closed higher, but memory -0.2933 and consumer electronics -0.0889 turned negative, so the AI complex is not broad on every read.
The A-share panel closed 6 of 11 higher, led by 688008.sh 5.5831 and 002156.sz 3.8248 — the mirror of the US memory weakness.
Reverse repo thinned again to 0.582 from 0.576, in the 4.34th percentile, while the dollar index rose to 119.5133.
watch_next: The FOMC meeting on 2026-09-28 is the next policy decision, with the implied rate at 4.15 still above the effective 3.88 — a hike remains the priced path.
Personal Income and Outlays (core PCE) and GDP both land on 2026-09-30, the first hard test of whether the real-rate constraint is biting activity.
Earnings season reopens with COST on 2026-09-24 and NKE on 2026-10-01, the first direct pricing of retail and consumer demand.

Whether the Saudi pipeline restart and the Iranian signalling on Hormuz actually deliver barrels: a lower crude price is the only near-term channel that eases the real-rate constraint without a policy move.
CICC A-shares resume trading on 2026-09-23 after the merger-related suspension, a reminder that domestic index flow is being reshaped by consolidation.

bull_case.title: Bull case: a lower oil price relaxes the real-rate constraint and the AI complex broadens
points: Neither risk channel is confirming stress: VIX 14.81 with realised vol 10.6356, HY OAS 2.68 and IG OAS 0.77.
The advance was not one sector: semiconductors 4.9281, quantum computing 4.7678, AI infrastructure 4.6307 and semis 4.1082, with 20 of 22 positive.
New highs at 0.0452 exceed new lows at 0.0387 while the index holds 7.919 above its 200-day average.

base_case.title: Base case: rates stay at their extreme and the rally grinds without broadening
points: Macro stays binding at 68.79, with the 10Y at 5.01 and the real rate at 2.68, both at the 100.0th percentile.
Breadth stays thin: cross-asset confirmation 0.375 and small cap relative -8.1362 limit how far the index move can travel.
The score added 0.84 to 44.05, but trend_1w at -1.18 and trend_1m at -0.65 show no durable direction.

bear_case.title: Bear case: the front end keeps repricing and the AI hardware leaders give back
points: The front end is doing the tightening: the 2Y moved 4.67 to 4.76 against a 10Y of only 4.94 to 5.01, taking the 10Y/2Y curve to 0.25.
Memory -0.2933 and consumer electronics -0.0889 fell inside a risk-on tape, so the leadership is narrowing at the margin.
The dollar at 119.5133 keeps dollar_strength triggered while semis relative -18.5165 shows the group is far from repaired.
